snippet.title: Starmax - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Starmax is a sci-fi roguelike bag-builder: a deck-builder where you draw from a bag instead of a deck. Shape your bag, build your base, and combine the two into one engine. Explore hostile planets, scavenge for resources, and ship your cargo before your base is overrun.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5300900/Starmax/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=announce-trailer

Music by: Christer Christensson

#indiegame #deckbuilder #deckbuilding  #roguelike
